attributes.name: Druva - Administrator Created
attributes.description: Detects creation of a new privileged administrator in Druva and identifies the account that was created, the creator, and the result.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects creation of a new privileged administrator in Druva and identifies the account that was created, the creator, and the result.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Administrator Created"
| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp
| EVAL new_admin =
    TO_STRING(user.email)
| EVAL created_by =
    TO_STRING(user.id)
| EVAL result =
    TO_STRING(event.outcome)
| WHERE new_admin IS NOT NULL
